subject: website
name: Rex Kirshner
summary: Rex Kirshner's Astro site. It stays at Level 2: when it opens it loads Google Tag Manager (gtag.js) from googletagmanager.com without an integrity hash, runs it in a Partytown frame and reports the visit to Google Analytics. It also loads images from cdn.rexkirshner.com.

connections.name: Google Tag Manager and Analytics (googletagmanager.com, google-analytics.com)
connections.note: Script and visit report loaded when the page opens.
